name: zyllotech-asset-management
description: ZylloTech Enterprise IT Asset Management System with Node.js, Express, SQLite and Vanilla JS

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('public')) fs.mkdirSync('public'); ['index.html','styles.css','app.js','zyllotech-logo.png','zyllotech-full-logo.png'].forEach(f => { if (fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'public/' + f); }); console.log('Static assets synced to public.');"

author: ZylloTech
